basics.name: Martin Birkenbaum
basics.label: Senior Software Engineer
basics.summary: Senior Software Engineer with 8+ years of experience designing, building, and deploying scalable backend services, microservices, and GitOps-driven automation for enterprise environments. Proven ability to deliver robust customer integrations and high-impact technical solutions, with a focus on full-stack development and operationalizing complex systems.

work.name: Initech Corporation
work.summary: Led architecture and development of high-throughput microservices and GitOps-driven infrastructure pipelines.
highlights: Designed and implemented high-throughput, Python-based event-driven microservices for scalable enterprise operations, processing 10M+ daily events.
Standardized secure, containerized deployments leveraging Docker, Kubernetes, and GitOps workflows to enhance operational stability in complex environments.
Mentored 6 junior/mid-level engineers, fostering strong technical practices and communication critical for collaborative development and customer-facing projects.
Developed custom internal toolchains and automation workflows, reducing CI pipeline execution times by 40% and enhancing developer productivity.

work.name: Hooli Inc.
work.summary: Backend engineer focused on building RESTful APIs, developer tooling, and automated deployment integrations.
highlights: Developed robust, scalable REST APIs using Python/Django and TypeScript/Node.js, supporting full-stack application requirements.
Successfully integrated third-party APIs and automated webhook processors, building critical connections for external developer platforms and enterprise systems.
Significantly enhanced system reliability by implementing comprehensive unit and integration tests, raising coverage from 60% to 92%.
